# Kafka Connect + Iceberg Sink: Configuration Reference

This document explains how the Strimzi / Kafka Connect / IcebergSinkConnector stack works, what named resources it creates, and what matters for ACL configuration.

## 3. Connector Configuration

#### Iceberg Control (internal coordination)

| Parameter | Value | Code default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `iceberg.connect.group-id` | `cg-<nsHash>-org-connector-group-id` | `connect-<connectorName>` | Group ID used by `CommitterImpl` for leader election; must match `consumer.override.group.id` |
| `iceberg.control.topic` | `t-<nsHash>-<fullResourceHash>-<product>-org-topic-control` | `control-iceberg` | Topic for Coordinator and Worker coordination |
| `iceberg.control.group-id-prefix` | `cg-<nsHash>-org-connector-iceberg-group-id` | `cg-control-` | Prefix for transient Worker group IDs; actual ID is prefix + UUID |
| `iceberg.coordinator.transactional.prefix` | `txn-<nsHash>-shared-cluster-txn` | `""` (empty) | Prefix for the Coordinator's transactional producer ID when writing to `control.topic` |
| `iceberg.control.commit.interval-ms` | 60000 | 300000 | Interval between Iceberg snapshots (ms) |
| `iceberg.control.commit.timeout-ms` | 300000 | 30000 | Timeout waiting for Worker responses before committing (ms) |
